I wish I didn't have to share this again. So many are going on like nothing happened. Thinking things were finally getting back to normal after George. Normal for who? #JacobBlake #BlackLivesMatter  #StopKillingUs 
Stop Killing Us: A Real Life Nightmare  https://t.co/Zih66yV0wP
Been following the case of #AnthonyMcClain in Pasadena since it happened. All the names don't trend. But we keep dying. #Blacklivesmatter

this has always been abt way more than bball. love the @Bucks for not just talking abt it but being abt it. peeping what comes next 👀 just one game? just one team? we damn well know it's not just one Black life... #StopKillingUs #BlackLivesMatter Arrest #BreonnaTaylor's killers.

It's hard for nonBlack folks to understand. The trauma we carry is real. You don't believe it unless you see it. Even then you don't like how we respond. One of ya'll grabs a gun, kills us. They live. #StopKillingUs #BlackTrauma is real. Valid. It matters. #BlackLivesMatter
In all of this, don't forget @Kaepernick7 been fighting for us. #BlackLivesMatter

The moment we hoped wasn’t coming, knew was coming, & that never really left. My pain is deeper than the thought process that results in 1 believing that shooting a man 7x in the back could ever be justified. #BlackLivesMatter #StopKillingUs #JacobBlake 
https://t.co/NrfxH4ibjG

White transpo twitter: this isn't a time for ppl to open their eyes & say they finally realize what I'm saying. I don't want to be right. I'm Black in America, I knew I was right. This is abt #DijonKizzee. 29 years young! Too soon. Support @BLMLA. #BlackLivesMatter #StopKillingUs
